en: The image features a sepia-toned portrait of a woman in an elegant dress standing indoors with a sheet of music or document in her hands. There are large floral arrangements and framed portraits in the background, indicating a cultured, perhaps artistic environment. The text at the top introduces 'Eva v. d. Osten, Kgl. sächs. Kammersängerin' (Royal Saxon chamber singer). The lower right corner credits the publisher 'Kunstverlag Emil Schwalb, Berlin-Charlottenburg 4', and a number '1146' is printed at the bottom left.
